supporting_observations.claim: The closest logged PowerShell process to the reported time started at 13:44:39 UTC on WS-MLOPEZ-01, about 4 minutes 39 seconds after 13:40. It ran as omar.haddad with the command `powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File \\FILE-HD-01\IT\Deploy-Patches.ps1`.
A network logon to WS-MLOPEZ-01 for omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01 preceded the PowerShell process; the logon was followed by a privileged-logon event.
The command matches the organization's stated workstation-patching practice and uses the specified patch script; patching was scheduled during business hours.
The PowerShell process launched wusa to install a Windows 11 update package, and the workstation made a Windows Update download through the proxy during the same period.
The PowerShell process and its child wusa process exited shortly after the update activity.

known_telemetry_limitations: The process records provide the PowerShell command line but not the contents, hash, or execution output of Deploy-Patches.ps1. (T024-00111, T024-00112)
The records establish a network logon attributed to omar.haddad from WS-OHADDAD-01, but do not independently confirm who initiated or authorized that session. (T024-00082)
The available records do not directly establish whether maria.lopez saw a window or the exact time she saw it.
claims_not_established: The contents and integrity of the patch script, and whether every action it performed was authorized, are not established by these records.
The evidence does not establish the precise time or duration of the window maria.lopez reported.
unrelated_findings: A workstation process used the svc-bkp account in an explicit-credentials event targeting PROXY-HD-01. The inventory describes svc-bkp as a backup agent account on FILE-HD-01; this usage merits separate review and does not decide the alerted PowerShell activity. (T024-00043)
GlobalProtect PanGPS.exe started on WS-MLOPEZ-01. The inventory says the organization has no VPN; this record shows process startup, not a VPN connection. Review separately. (T024-00039, T024-00040)

Google Drive File Stream started under maria.lopez, and a Google Update request followed. The inventory approves OneDrive but no other cloud-storage services; these records do not establish that files were synced or uploaded. Review separately. (T024-00278, T024-00280, T024-00281, T024-00282)
